text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a High Wind Watch for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. Watch for a crash or incident at I-295 northbound (4.9 mi away). It's 63°F, Mostly Sunny, up to 63°.

weatherAlerts.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 23 at 2:00PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.
